sets.title: Future Aspect Quiz
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите несовершенный или совершенный вид в будущем времени

items.prompt: Завтра весь день я _____ отчёт. (Tomorrow I'll be writing the report all day.)
items.promptEnglish: Tomorrow I'll be writing the report all day.
items.hint: Extended future activity (весь день) = imperfective future.
items.explanation: Duration (весь день) requires imperfective future: буду писать (extended process).

items.prompt: Я обязательно _____ тебе завтра. (I'll definitely call you tomorrow.)
items.hint: Single specific future action with result = perfective future.
items.explanation: Single completed future action: perfective позвоню (one call, result achieved).

items.prompt: Что ты _____ делать в выходные? (What will you be doing this weekend?)
items.promptEnglish: What will you be doing this weekend?
items.hint: Asking about future plans/activities (process) = imperfective future.
items.explanation: Asking about planned activities uses imperfective: будешь делать.

items.prompt: Она _____ эту книгу за неделю. (She'll read this book in a week.)
items.promptEnglish: She'll finish this book in a week.
items.hint: Completion within a timeframe (за неделю) = perfective future.
items.explanation: За + time (within a timeframe) signals completion: perfective прочитает.

items.prompt: Летом мы _____. (In summer we'll be traveling.)
items.hint: Extended future activity over a period = imperfective.
items.explanation: Extended summer-long activity: imperfective future будем путешествовать.
Single specific future event: perfective придёт (will arrive).

items.prompt: Каждый день я _____ заниматься спортом. (Every day I'll be exercising.)
items.explanation: Repeated future actions (каждый день) use imperfective: буду заниматься.

minimalPairs.context: Завтра я _____ книгу. (I'll be reading a book tomorrow - extended activity.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Tomorrow I'll be reading a book (process, extended).
minimalPairs.explanation: Extended future activity without emphasis on completion: imperfective буду читать.

minimalPairs.context: Завтра я _____ эту книгу. (I'll finish this book tomorrow - result.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Tomorrow I'll finish reading this book.
minimalPairs.explanation: Completion with result: perfective прочитаю (will read and finish).

minimalPairs.context: Вечером я _____ ужин. (I'll be cooking dinner this evening - process.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I'll be cooking dinner this evening (process).
minimalPairs.explanation: Future process: imperfective буду готовить (will be cooking).

minimalPairs.context: Я _____ ужин к семи часам. (I'll have dinner ready by seven - result.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I'll have dinner ready by seven.
minimalPairs.explanation: Result by a deadline: perfective приготовлю (will cook and finish by seven).

sets.title: Fill and Correct
sets.description: Fill in the right future form and fix errors
sets.descriptionRussian: Заполните форму будущего времени и исправьте ошибки

blanks: Что вы _____ делать после работы? (What will you be doing after work?)
Я _____ эту задачу за час. (I'll solve this problem in an hour.)
В субботу мы _____ в парке. (On Saturday we'll be walking in the park.)
Она _____ домой и сразу ляжет спать. (She'll come home and immediately go to sleep.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Process/plans = imperfective future; single result = perfective future
hints: Asking about future plans (open-ended activity). Which future?
Completion within a timeframe (за час). Which aspect?
Extended activity on Saturday. Which future?
Single arrival followed by next action. Which aspect?
explanations: Asking about future activities: imperfective будете (делать).
Extended future activity: imperfective будем гулять.

errorCorrection.sentence: Завтра я буду решить эту задачу.
errorCorrection.hint: Буду + infinitive must use the imperfective infinitive, not perfective.
errorCorrection.explanation: The буду + infinitive construction uses imperfective: буду решать. For perfective future, just conjugate: решу.

errorCorrection.hint: Perfective verbs don't use буду. Just conjugate the perfective verb.
errorCorrection.explanation: Perfective future = just the conjugated form: придёт (not будет прийти). Only imperfective uses буду + infinitive.

errorCorrection.hint: Весь день (all day) emphasizes duration/process. Which future form?
errorCorrection.explanation: Duration (весь день) needs imperfective future: буду писать, not perfective напишу.

items.prompt: Which is the correct imperfective future of читать?
items.explanation: Imperfective future: буду + infinitive: буду читать.

items.prompt: Я _____ тебе, когда приеду. (I'll write to you when I arrive.)
items.promptEnglish: I'll write to you when I arrive.
items.hint: Single action upon arrival = perfective future.
items.explanation: Single future action with result: perfective напишу.

items.prompt: Мы долго _____ решение. (We'll be thinking about the decision for a long time.)
items.promptEnglish: We'll think about the decision for a long time.
items.hint: Долго (for a long time) = extended process = imperfective.
items.explanation: Duration (долго) requires imperfective future: будем обсуждать.

sets.title: Sort and Build
sets.description: Sort by future type and build future sentences
sets.descriptionRussian: Рассортируйте и постройте предложения в будущем времени

categorySorting.instruction: Sort: Imperfective future (process/duration) or Perfective future (result/completion)?

blanks: Мы _____ в кафе в субботу. (We'll go to the cafe on Saturday. - single trip)
Каждый день я _____ русский язык. (Every day I'll be studying Russian.)
Он _____ и сразу уйдёт. (He'll eat and leave immediately.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Single event = perfective; repeated activity = imperfective
hints: Single trip on Saturday. Which future?
Completed action before leaving. Which future?
explanations: Repeated future activity: imperfective буду учить.
Completed action in sequence: perfective поест.

translation.english: I'll be working all day tomorrow.
translation.answer: Завтра я буду работать весь день.
acceptableVariants: Завтра весь день я буду работать.
translation.hint: Extended process (all day) = imperfective future: буду работать

translation.english: She'll call you when she arrives.
translation.hint: Single action upon arrival = perfective: позвонит, приедет
translation.grammarFocus: Perfective future for single completed actions

translation.english: What will you be doing this evening?
translation.answer: Что ты будешь делать сегодня вечером?
acceptableVariants: Что вы будете делать сегодня вечером?
translation.hint: Asking about plans/activities = imperfective future: будешь делать

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: Both future types in various contexts
sets.descriptionRussian: Оба типа будущего времени в разных контекстах

items.prompt: Я _____ тебя у входа в семь. (I'll wait for you at the entrance at seven.)
items.promptEnglish: I'll be waiting for you at the entrance at seven.
items.hint: Process of waiting (not a single result) = imperfective future.
items.explanation: Waiting is a process, not a single result: imperfective буду ждать.

items.prompt: Когда _____ дождь, мы пойдём гулять. (When the rain stops, we'll go for a walk.)
items.promptEnglish: When the rain stops, we'll go for a walk.
items.hint: Rain stopping is a single completed event. Which future?
items.explanation: Single completed event (rain stopping): perfective кончится.

items.prompt: В университете она _____ медицину. (At university she'll be studying medicine.)
items.promptEnglish: At university she'll be studying medicine.
items.explanation: Extended ongoing studies: imperfective будет изучать.

errorCorrection.hint: Буду requires imperfective infinitive. Написать is perfective.
errorCorrection.explanation: Буду + infinitive must be imperfective: буду писать. For perfective, use напишу (no буду).

errorCorrection.hint: Каждый день = repeated. Repeated future actions need imperfective.
errorCorrection.explanation: Repeated future (каждый день) requires imperfective: будет решать, not perfective решит.

errorCorrection.hint: Долго (for a long time) needs process/duration = imperfective.
errorCorrection.explanation: Duration (долго) requires imperfective: буду звонить, not perfective позвоню.
